cases.name: task_waiting_for_review_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: A task its supervisor judged finished (pending_review), from a hub that does not say since when (no pending_since): it is in Needs you and not in In progress, as before the supervisor's review had its own place. The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).

cases.name: task_waiting_for_decision_only_in_needs_you
cases.description: A task with an open ask (decide) and a needs_user one are both in Needs you, once each, even while the first one's agent still works.

cases.name: supervisor_review_in_progress
cases.description: A task judged finished waits for its supervisor's review, not the owner's: while the review is younger than an hour (pending_since) it is in In progress and not in Needs you. One second short of the hour still is; so is one the owner already looked at, because Seen neither accepts nor files supervised work (#5732). The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).
source: docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Needs you and In progress

cases.name: supervisor_review_with_open_pr
cases.description: A task whose fresh, open PR waits for a maintainer (the web's Waiting for merge, #7614) and whose supervisor's review is under way: the review is Persona's own work, so it is in In progress saying its supervisor is reviewing it, not Waiting for merge, even after the owner looked at it; Seen neither accepts the work nor moves it to Waiting for merge (#5732). Once the review is overdue it is the owner's: Needs you wins over the PR. Clients without the Waiting for merge group read the same split. The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).
source: docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Needs you and In progress

cases.name: overdue_supervisor_review_needs_you
cases.description: A review still waiting an hour after the task entered pending_review comes to the owner: at the hour exactly and after it the task is in Needs you, as before, so a stalled or missing supervisor never hides a finished task. The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).
source: docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Needs you and In progress

cases.name: review_without_pending_since_needs_you
cases.description: A hub that does not send pending_since (or sends one that is no time) keeps the old rule: the task waiting for review is in Needs you. The ledger's updated_at is not read in its place. The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).
source: docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Needs you and In progress

cases.name: owner_decisions_stay_in_needs_you_during_a_fresh_review
cases.description: What is the owner's stays the owner's however young the review: a pending_review task whose agent asks something, one with an open ask (please verify), and a needs_user task are in Needs you; the fresh review next to them is in In progress. The web lists the review rows under its Persona reviewing entry instead (web_review, #8678).
source: docs/assistant/unified-entry.md Needs you and In progress

cases.name: finished_tasks_in_neither
cases.description: Done, cancelled and accepted tasks are in neither entry. The ones the conversation handed out that finished in the last 24 hours are under Finished (#10922), newest finished first and the same moment by id; nobody opened them yet, so all three are new. The board has every finished task.

cases.name: finished_lists_the_last_day_seen_or_not
cases.description: Finished (#10922) lists the tasks handed out (by this or, in the main conversation, any conversation) that finished in the last 24 hours, seen or not, newest finished first. A task finished when the To-dos triage says: its close (t-new, t-seen, t-other, t-almost), its accepting review (t-accepted), else its last move for a finished turn the owner has already seen (t-read, which the To-dos page files under Done). Seeing a task changes only whether it is new (finished_new: the To-dos page's Just finished). Exactly 24 hours ago is out (t-day), one second less is in (t-almost); older ones (t-old), a to-do made by hand (t-by-hand) and an old failed start (t-failed) are not listed. Finished rows are not open work.

cases.name: finished_only_the_conversations_own
cases.description: Another conversation's Finished lists only the tasks it handed out (origin), as its other entries do (#10922); the main conversation's work is the main conversation's.

cases.name: plan_and_message_wait_for_the_user

cases.name: superseded_failed_start_in_neither
cases.description: A task whose agent never started, in the same plan as a task that really finished (a review closed it): the work got done, so the failed start waits on nobody and is finished, in neither entry and not under Finished, as the To-dos page has it (#3713); the task that finished is under Finished (#10922). Another failed start with nothing finished beside it still needs the user.

cases.name: Only open delivery holds assigned to the owner need their attention
supervised_delivery_hold_with_its_supervisor
cases.description: An Agent's closeout held a supervised task's delivery for the owner, but no review came since: the hub sends unblock supervisor (#13191). It is its supervisor's to turn into a real decision, park or send on, so it is in In progress with its supervisor reviewing, never in Needs you; the web lists it under Persona reviewing (web_review). Once the supervisor opens needs_user, the hold is unblock user again and the task is in Needs you. A client that does not know the value treats it as not the owner's.

cases.name: finished_tasks_with_leftover_asks_in_neither
cases.description: An ask makes a task the owner's only while the task is open, as the hub's To-dos triage has it (#12974). A task its supervisor's accepting review closed, whose "please verify" ask was left on it (t-verified), is under Finished like any other task that finished in the last day, not in Needs you; so is a closed task that still carries a decision or a cannot ask (t-old-decision is older than a day, t-cannot was made by hand: in no entry). Only the open task's decision (t-open-decision) waits on the owner. A withdrawn plan (p-withdrawn) is not a row; the open one (p-open) is. Every Needs you row is one the tray lists, so its count is these rows.
